QUOTE: The asm is gated on `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`, which is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on and the compiler is GNU-compatible (`__GNUC__`) or ARM Compiler (`__ARMCC_VERSION`) (`constant_time_impl.h:40-52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros (`__GNUC__`, `__ARMCC_VERSION`), which is the derivation the item describes. It never says the macro is absent from mbedtls_config.h, but the derivation implies it.
